subject: modal successor sets
statement: The paper proves that modal successor sets are constant on compatibility components.

subject: component modalities
statement: The paper establishes a complete proof theory for component modalities.

subject: algebraic matroids
statement: The paper proves that the recognition problem for algebraic matroids is undecidable.

subject: algebraic matroids
statement: The paper proves that recognition of algebraic matroids remains undecidable when the characteristic is fixed to a prime p.

subject: Lebesgue measurable sets
statement: The paper proves stronger forms of theorems about the locatedness of Lebesgue measurable complemented sets in R^N.

subject: minimal well-determined logic
statement: The paper constructs a semantics for the minimal well-determined logic based on lower semilattices with a greatest element.

subject: minimal well-determined logic
statement: The paper proves soundness and completeness theorems for the minimal well-determined logic.

subject: tautologies
statement: The paper proves that the set of tautologies of the minimal well-determined logic is decidable in polynomial time.

subject: paraconsistent integration theory
statement: The paper embeds the integration theory of the Levi-Civita field into the paraconsistent Chunk and Permeate framework.

subject: Dominated Convergence Theorem
statement: The paper shows that the Dominated Convergence Theorem permeates from the Levi-Civita field to classical reals, yielding the Lebesgue Dominated Convergence Theorem.

subject: uniform bound extraction
statement: The paper extends uniform bound extraction theorems from normed structures to abstract metric structures.

subject: stable subsets of groups
statement: The paper provides novel explicit bounds for a structural theorem for stable subsets of groups.

subject: 2-stationarity of P_κλ
statement: The paper proves that strong compactness of κ does not imply the 2-stationarity of P_κλ for cardinals λ > κ.

subject: tree-derived ideals
statement: The paper develops machinery for deriving ideals from tree-indexed partitions via a derivative operator parameterized by an auxiliary ideal.

subject: Katetov reduction
statement: The paper proves that the inductive limit F_ω is not Katetov-reducible to the transfinite hierarchy H_ω.

subject: Cantor-Bendixson and derivative ranks
statement: The paper proves the orthogonality of Cantor-Bendixson and derivative ranks.

subject: conuclei on hoops
statement: The paper provides a Glivenko-type theorem for conuclei on varieties of hoops.

subject: multiplicative conuclei
statement: The paper gives an explicit description of all terms that define a multiplicative conucleus on every structure of an arbitrary proper variety of Wajsberg hoops.

subject: Boolean Prime Ideal Theorem
statement: The paper proves the consistency of Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory with Axiom of Dependent Choices, no Vitali sets, and a large fragment of the Boolean Prime Ideal Theorem.

subject: Zarankiewicz bounds
statement: The paper establishes almost-linear Zarankiewicz bounds for semilinear relations in valued vector spaces.

subject: hereditary almost-linear profiles
statement: The paper proves a relative extension theorem for intersecting relations with hereditary almost-linear profiles.

subject: large rosy fields
statement: The paper shows that large rosy fields are bounded.

subject: large stable and simple fields
statement: The paper substantially simplifies proofs that large stable fields are separably closed and large simple fields are bounded.

subject: vector space endomorphisms
statement: The paper simplifies the axiomatization of model companions for endomorphisms of vector spaces with extra structure.

subject: definable endomorphisms
statement: The paper characterizes all ∅-definable endomorphisms of K-vector spaces.

subject: QBism Logic
statement: The paper develops a logical formalization of QBism based on admissible prior spaces, measurements, Born kernels, and update kernels.

subject: QBism logic
statement: The paper proves a global reduction theorem for the guarded dynamic language in QBism logic.

subject: validity in QBism
object: sound complete calculus with decision procedure
statement: The paper proves a sound and complete recursive calculus and provides a decision procedure for validity in QBism logic.

subject: Phoa principle
statement: The paper provides a generalization of the Phoa principle to transfinite cases in synthetic domain theory.

subject: sobriomorphisms
statement: The paper introduces sobriomorphisms and a new interpretation of the Phoa principle.

subject: completeness in synthetic domain theory
statement: The paper proposes a hypothetical completeness theorem unifying Segal completeness and chain completeness in synthetic domain theory.

subject: maximal eventually different families
statement: The paper defines mass problems of maximal eventually different families of computable functions and compares them against mass problems of maximal almost disjoint families.

subject: mass problems
statement: The paper shows that the abstract framework of Greenberg, Kuyper, and Turetsky is suitable for obtaining results in the setting of mass problems.

subject: Hindman's theorem
statement: The paper proves that Hindman's theorem does not code ∅^(ω) in one application.

subject: semiproducts of modal logics
statement: The paper presents new examples of product and semiproduct logics of propositional modal logics with S5 that have the finite model property.

subject: modal logic products
statement: The paper proves local tabularity of these products for logics of finite depth using bisimulation games.

subject: modal logic semiproducts
statement: The paper presents new counterexamples of semiproducts not axiomatizable in the simplest way.

subject: Tarski geometry of solids
statement: The paper formalizes the reconstruction of point-like objects from concentric families of spherical regions in Tarski's geometry of solids.

subject: Kuratowski closure operator
statement: The paper proves that the neighbourhood-based closure operator on point-class plurals satisfies the four Kuratowski closure axioms.
